title: Directed Roads
statementMd:
ZS the Coder and Chris the Baboon has explored Udayland for quite some time. They realize that it consists of $*n*$ towns numbered from $1$ to $*n*$.

There are $*n*$ directed roads in the Udayland. $*i*$-th of them goes from town $*i*$ to some other town $*a*_{*i*}$ ($*a*_{*i*} ≠ *i*$). ZS the Coder can flip the direction of any road in Udayland, i.e. if it goes from town $*A*$ to town $*B*$ before the flip, it will go from town $*B*$ to town $*A*$ after.

ZS the Coder considers the roads in the Udayland *confusing*, if there is a sequence of distinct towns $*A*_{1}, *A*_{2}, ..., *A*_{*k*}$ ($*k* > 1$) such that for every $1 ≤ *i* < *k*$ there is a road from town $*A*_{*i*}$ to town $*A*_{*i* + 1}$ and another road from town $*A*_{*k*}$ to town $*A*_{1}$. In other words, the roads are confusing if **some of them** form a directed cycle of some towns.

Now ZS the Coder wonders how many sets of roads (there are $2^{*n*}$ variants) in initial configuration can he choose to flip such that after flipping each road in the set exactly once, the resulting network will **not** be confusing.

Note that it is allowed that after the flipping there are more than one directed road from some town and possibly some towns with no roads leading out of it, or multiple roads between any pair of cities.

## Input

The first line of the input contains single integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$) — the number of towns in Udayland.

The next line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ *n*, *a*_{*i*} ≠ *i*)$, $*a*_{*i*}$ denotes a road going from town $*i*$ to town $*a*_{*i*}$.

## Output

Print a single integer — the number of ways to flip some set of the roads so that the resulting whole set of all roads is not confusing. Since this number may be too large, print the answer modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

## Note

Consider the first sample case. There are $3$ towns and $3$ roads. The towns are numbered from $1$ to $3$ and the roads are ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e5b18c46402af724bd3841d549d5d6f52fc16253.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/29f71c065c3536e88b54429c734103ad3604f68b.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/030fc9181b578c2d906254d38dc56da5554323eb.png) initially. Number the roads $1$ to $3$ in this order.

The sets of roads that ZS the Coder can flip (to make them not confusing) are ${1}, {2}, {3}, {1, 2}, {1, 3}, {2, 3}$. Note that the empty set is invalid because if no roads are flipped, then towns $1, 2, 3$ is form a directed cycle, so it is confusing. Similarly, flipping all roads is confusing too. Thus, there are a total of $6$ possible sets ZS the Coder can flip.

The sample image shows all possible ways of orienting the roads from the first sample such that the network is **not confusing**.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a30b99a53a8379be1c9aa034cc94d80131d3770c.png)
statementZhMd:
ZS the Coder 和 Chris the Baboon 已经探索 Udayland 很长一段时间了。他们发现，Udayland 由编号从 $*1*$ 到 $*n*$ 的 $*n*$ 个城镇组成。

Udayland 中有 $*n*$ 条有向道路。其中第 $*i*$ 条道路从城镇 $*i*$ 通往另一个城镇 $*a*_{*i*}$（$*a*_{*i*} ≠ *i*$）。ZS the Coder 可以翻转 Udayland 中任意一条道路的方向，即如果翻转前道路从城镇 $*A*$ 通往城镇 $*B*$，那么翻转后它将从城镇 $*B*$ 通往城镇 $*A*$。

如果存在一个由不同城镇组成的序列 $*A*_{1}, *A*_{2}, ..., *A*_{*k*}$（$*k* > 1$），使得对于每个 $1 ≤ *i* < *k*$，都有一条从城镇 $*A*_{*i*}$ 通往城镇 $*A*_{*i* + 1}$ 的道路，并且还有另一条从城镇 $*A*_{*k*}$ 通往城镇 $*A*_{1}$ 的道路，那么 ZS the Coder 就认为 Udayland 中的道路令人困惑。换句话说，如果**其中一些道路**构成了若干城镇的有向环，那么这些道路就是令人困惑的。

现在，ZS the Coder 想知道，在初始状态下有多少种道路集合（共有 $2^{*n*}$ 种），使得他将集合中的每条道路恰好翻转一次后，得到的道路网络**不会**令人困惑。

注意，翻转后，某个城镇可能有多条通往其他城镇的有向道路，也可能有些城镇没有向外的道路；任意一对城镇之间也可能存在多条道路。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$）——Udayland 中城镇的数量。

下一行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$*a*_{*i*} ≠ *i*$），其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示一条从城镇 $*i*$ 通往城镇 $*a*_{*i*}$ 的道路。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——翻转某个道路集合，使翻转后的全部道路不会令人困惑的方案数。由于答案可能很大，请将答案对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模后输出。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例。共有 $3$ 个城镇和 $3$ 条道路。城镇编号从 $1$ 到 $3$，道路最初如图所示：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e5b18c46402af724bd3841d549d5d6f52fc16253.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/29f71c065c3536e88b54429c734103ad3604f68b.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/030fc9181b578c2d906254d38dc56da5554323eb.png)。按照此顺序将道路编号为 $1$ 到 $3$。

ZS the Coder 可以翻转的道路集合为 ${1}, {2}, {3}, {1, 2}, {1, 3}, {2, 3}$，从而使道路不再令人困惑。注意，空集合是无效的，因为如果不翻转任何道路，那么城镇 $1, 2, 3$ 将构成一个有向环，因此道路是令人困惑的。同样，翻转所有道路也会令人困惑。因此，ZS the Coder 总共有 $6$ 个可行的道路集合可供翻转。

样例图片展示了第一组样例中，使道路网络**不令人困惑**的所有道路方向方案。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a30b99a53a8379be1c9aa034cc94d80131d3770c.png)
